biotools.summary: ExMdb is a database of exosomal nucleic acid biomarkers and disease-gene associations curated from published literature and high-throughput datasets. It provides comprehensive data on gene-disease associations, biomarkers, and subcellular locations, along with high-throughput sequencing datasets.
